permission: Owner: Use labelled estimates only where necessary.
scope: Seven catalogued scenarios. Source objectives/observations retained; closed numerical and event rules are project adaptations. No new missions inferred from promotional aliases.

common_rules.offer: Docked services Operations board; choose scenario and Easy/Hard, one instance at a time; no rank/credit gate (estimated project policy).
common_rules.participants: 1..4; host-authoritative shared objective IDs, no progress from duplicate deaths/events. Solo supported.

scaling.limits: Apply to hostile counts/energy/damage and positive objective deadlines only. Do not scale relay/regulator/people counts, interaction/download duration or phase ordering.

common_rules.world: Use fixed authored relative layout; Runner at[0,0,0], objective vessel/settlement origin[0,0,200000]. Ground layout is a project grid in metres; no claim to reproduce ED maps.

foot_layout.spawn_rule: Distribute unique enemy IDs around40-metre ring, project to valid floor/navmesh, never underground. Give later waves fresh IDs.

common_rules.deadlines: Persist monotonic remaining simulation seconds. Failure at elapsed>=duration; exact-equality failure is estimated. Process expiration before success on same tick. Save/pause suspends simulation time.
common_rules.objectives: Only designated instance IDs count. Shared counters monotonic; killed/recovered/unloaded IDs retained. Completed stages do not repopulate on reload.
common_rules.passengers: Unique people occupy passenger berths; load only available seats; count success on unloading at rescue vessel, never simply on pickup. Dead/lost passengers fail the instance; no silent respawn.
common_rules.death_retry: Estimated: respawn at Runner after15 seconds with owned gear restored to pre-death instance condition; instance counters/time persist. Quitting fails instance and clears mission-owned passengers/items, restoring stored personal equipment. No success reward on failure. New retry gets fresh instance UUID/seed.
common_rules.extraction: Spawn Runner after authored delay. Accept only when all connected participating commanders board; allow solo. Disconnected participants are removed from quorum, with their carried quest people safely returned to pickup pool (estimated project policy).
common_rules.rewards: Pay fixed configured common-project credits once per successful instance; no merit/material imitation without separate specification. No extra reward per respawned enemy.

npc_roles.status: estimated project loadouts; historical ED NPCs not claimed

fighter.ai: close to laser range, dogfight player, retreat below10% energy

boss.ai: stay within15000 of objective and engage; no escape before objective death

guard.ai: use navmesh cover within30m, fire on visible participant, approach if no shot

researcher.ai: flee toward authored escape point; escaping fails designated-target stage

common_rules.combat_units: Ship stats/lasers use the separately labelled common project profiles/O08 weapon units. Ground metres/seconds/health are estimates; do not mix them with raw model scale.
common_rules.unknown_source_parameters: Every numerical map, quota, population, reward, fit and unreported timer is individually marked estimated in stage parameters or common section. Measured/reported figures explicitly identify D19.
common_rules.default_hostile_role: fighter when an authored ship count has no role override; guard for on-foot counts (estimated)
common_rules.waves: Spawn first authored wave on stage entry. Spawn next only after every previous-wave objective ID is dead. After final quota, stop replacement spawns and order surplus foes away. Initial reinforcements occur one full configured interval after entry.
common_rules.spawn_geometry: Estimated: ship waves evenly spaced on a ring at configured radius around objective origin, first angle determined by saved instance seed; face player. Ground enemies use valid-floor40m ring. Capital relays use six equally spaced target positions on a200m ring around vessel local longitudinal axis; these are provisional layout values, not native ED geometry.
common_rules.power_puzzle: Estimated: regulator items have unique IDs; install2 exactly once. Wrong breaker order resets breaker progress only; installed regulators remain.
common_rules.heat_termination: Estimated: heat runs during access/rescue and stops after all passengers are safely unloaded. At threshold100 before quota, fail; vent use is a one-time five-second action per vent.
common_rules.capital_damage: Estimated: mission capital root is not the kill objective and ignores ordinary hull damage. Only unique relay destruction advances progress; final relay triggers retreat. This override belongs only to the mission instance, not the playable hull.
common_rules.ground_player: Estimated common player: health100, shield100, shield recharge10/s after5s without damage, walk3m/s, sprint6m/s. Starting weapon uses guard weapon numeric parameters with player-controlled aim, no random hit-probability gate. Damage drains shields then health; no invented armour resistance.
common_rules.ground_ai_sampling: Estimated: guard fires at configured interval when line-of-sight and range pass; each shot uses saved RNG and hit probability. No shot through solid geometry or floor. Dead unique actor IDs cannot be credited twice.
